claim: A parallax sky drawn in several panels needs the map header's sky bits and offsets: E1M5 wears tile 3678 with sky_bits 4 and offsets 0 to 15, sixteen panels round (so do the nine other campaign maps that wear it). Our E4L1 map set the tile with sky_bits 0 and one offset, so only the first panel was drawn, and it drew as broken bands.
evidence: E1M5 s392 and 30 other sectors wear 3678 as a parallax ceiling; read_map(E1M5).header sky_bits 4, sky_offsets 0..15

projects/duke-e4l1-remake/passes/02-storm-panorama-and-service-gate.json (sky bits 0 to 4, offsets [0] to 0..15, after E1M5); projects/duke-e4l1-remake/DESIGN.md: the first tile alone produced broken bands
use: Copy the sky bits and offsets of a campaign map that wears the same sky.

checked.how: read_map(E1M5): header sky_bits 4, sky_offsets 0..15; s392 ceiling 3678 stat 1, 31 sectors so. Ten campaign maps wear 3678 parallax, all with offsets 0..15. E4L1-baseline.MAP: sky_bits 0, offsets [0]; passes/02-storm-panorama-and-service-gate.json sets bits 0->4 and offsets [0]->0..15, citing E1M5; DESIGN.md:95-98 says the first tile alone drew broken bands.
